Sanofi initiated the reported process with a non-binding $52.50-per-share proposal received on April 15, 2016, which Medivation rejected while Sanofi continued pursuing the company. Pfizer approached Medivation in April and signed a confidentiality agreement on June 29, and Medivation announced confidentiality agreements with several parties on July 5. Pfizer submitted a $65.00-per-share cash proposal on August 8 and was invited with several other interested parties to further diligence on August 10. After supplying a merger-agreement markup, Pfizer offered $77.00 per share in cash on August 19 and was asked for its best and final offer. Pfizer offered $81.50 per share in cash on August 20, the parties signed that afternoon, and the transaction was announced on August 22. The filing does not identify the other subsequent-stage bidders or report their offers, so their exact numbers and continuity remain unreported.
